notes.title: Entodrive Community Update #6
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DRcLbK-EG50;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Entodrive players!
Here's what I've been working on for this update :

Music :
I have replaced about half of the game's soundtrack with new music. Most of the new music was made by Liam Bradbury from his Complete RPG Chiptunes Pack. Special thank you to him for providing new music for the game.

Battle Animations
Monster animations are no longer just idle loops on the battle screen. Player & Enemy monsters will now display hit and attack animations. I may improve on this in the future with physical/special/status attack anim variants. Making these animation changes I actually cut about 3.5 seconds of mandatory time while in battle. I also changed it so that you can select a move by double clicking instead of using the confirm button in battle. Battles should be quicker and more responsive now. 

Momentum Changes
To prevent falling down slopes, I've applied more static friction to the base player movement. To coincide with this I've also changed it so you can only move in one direction at a time. Before you could apply force in two directions doubling your speed, which caused glitches and exploits.

Bug Fixes
Set a limit to how far the player can fall, so it will now reroute out of bounds players to the nearest map on that level. I fixed a crash when Entodrive report cards are read instantly when just loading a level. Fixed a crash when following Entodrive aren't spawned on a nav mesh. 

Steam Guide NPCS
I've added Steam Guide helper NPCs around Cache Isle that give you hints about the game and resources to help you. They will also be present around areas that have seasonal events so you can know what time of the year to come back and where.

Lost During Your Playthrough?

Check out the steam guides :
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2472674974
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2603495916

If you have any issues or bugs during your playthrough please reach out here on the Steam forums and I'll do my best to fix your issues swiftly. 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1520710/discussions/2/

Thank you everyone for over 3 years of support on Entodrive! The sequel Entodrive : Auburn is currently in production! There's some wip footage on my youtube channel you can check out. I'll keep you updated on its development and bring you some community updates to the original game along the way!

notes.notes:
What I've Been Working On :
[previewyoutube=gGEoua2PNz4;full][/previewyoutube]
+Added new item instantiator
+Instantiator allows you to enable 1st crew member to follow from your storage

Note from Dev :
Hey everyone! Hope you're doing well and enjoy this update. Entodrive can follow you now! You can get any item as a reward for hanging out with your Entodrive if they find it. They'll drop it on the ground and you'll hear a chime. Hope it helps your farming endeavors. Just wanted to let you know, I'm still making games! Working on an on going comic book superhero platformer on Steam right now! On top of that have been dabbling at a horror game over on my twitter. I appreciate the love and support you have all given Entodrive. It has allowed me to afford to keep doing what I love and bring you these updates from time to time.

notes.title: Entodrive Community Update #4
notes.notes:
What I've Been Working On :
[previewyoutube=PWMabJFXjMg;full][/previewyoutube]
+Did a level rework for Kojo City
+Added a Marina to Kojo City
+Removed some buildings and shuffled objects around in Kojo
+Replaced old unoptimized geometry in Kojo with more optimized terrain
+Updated the battle background for Kojo
+New seasonal event "Conflict at the Marina" in Kojo every September starting now
+New Achievement for partaking in the event
+Rebattle crews from Alder Village as they travel to Kojo by boat
+Win rare items
+Event can be played infinite times through September
+In October the Pumpkin Harvest Event returns!
+In October head to Magic town for a chance to catch multiple starters
+Fixed bug where left and right on the dpad would stop working in some scenes

Note from Dev :
Apologies on the delay for this community update. I had a lot of personal stuff come up that I dont have go into. I will be removing the next update by date for Entodrive. I'm learning a lot about balance and being kind to myself this year after releasing 3 games on my own. Most of my attention going forward will be towards future projects like Spryward, but dont be surprised if you see some Entodrive updates sprinkled out through Spryward's early access. I do have a fun Entodrive related project in the works. Be sure to follow the other games in the Apastron universe for a continuation of the story and hints for the future of Entodrive. My family is getting a Steam Deck this week, so I'll be able to work on specific Entodrive improvements/optimizations for it. Thanks for reading/playing! I hope to update you with some more Entodrive news soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1862420
